common.maintenance_scheduled_body: The system will be unavailable from {{start}} until {{end}}. Save your work before then.
common.maintenance_active_title: Maintenance mode is on — tenant users are locked out
common.maintenance_active_body: Ends {{end}} (in {{countdown}}). Only landlords can use the system.
common.maintenance_page_offline_note: Field agents: keep recording payments in the mobile app — they are saved on the phone and sync automatically when maintenance ends.
common.maintenance_page_refreshes: This page updates itself when the system is back.

account.title: My account
account.impersonating_notice: You are viewing this account as a landlord. Only its owner can change the profile, email, password, two-factor or sessions.
account.name: Name
account.email_help: Sign-in codes and security notices go here. A new address is confirmed with a code sent to it.
account.email_code_sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Enter it to finish the change. Until then, your current email stays in use.
account.password_help: Changing your password signs you out of every other session and device.
account.two_factor_help: After your password, also ask for a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…).
account.setup_step_install: Install an authenticator app on your phone.
account.setup_step_scan: Scan this QR code with it, or type the setup key.
account.setup_step_code: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
account.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
account.regenerate_help: Your current recovery codes will stop working.
account.disable_help: Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).
account.recovery_codes_help: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
account.sessions_help: Where your account is signed in: browsers and the mobile app.
account.sign_out_others: Sign out of all other sessions and devices
